```{r,echo=FALSE}
library(reticulate)
options(scipen=999)
# a = sample(c(-9:-1,1:9),1)
# b = sample(c(-9:-1,1:9),1)
# c = sample(c(-9:-1,1:9),1)
# d = sample(c(-9:-1,1:9),1)



cn = function(a,b){
  cn = gsub("+-","-",paste0(a,"+",b,"i"),fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("0+0i","0",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("+1i","+i",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("-1i","-i",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("+0i","",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  cn = gsub("-0i","",cn,fixed=TRUE)
  if(nchar(cn)>1 && substr(cn,1,2)=="0+"){cn = gsub("0+","",cn,fixed=TRUE)}
  if(nchar(cn)>1 && substr(cn,1,2)=="0-"){cn = gsub("0-","-",cn,fixed=TRUE)}
  return(cn)
}

abcd = sample(1:9,4)
a = abcd[1]*sample(c(-1,1),1)
b = abcd[2]*sample(c(-1,1),1)
c = abcd[3]*sample(c(-1,1),1)
d = abcd[4]*sample(c(-1,1),1)
cn1 = cn(a,b)
cn2 = cn(c,d)
cn3 = cn(a+c,b+d)

rpo = c(a+c,a-c,-a+c,-a-c)
ipo = c(b+d,b-d,-b+d,-b-d)

ach = character()
for(rr in rpo){
    for(ii in ipo){
        ach = c(ach,paste0(cn(rr,ii)))
    }
}
ach = sort(unique(ach))


al = paste0("* $",ach,"$",collapse="\n")
sol = paste0(1*(ach==cn3),collapse="")


```

Question
========

Find the sum of the two complex numbers.
$$(`r cn1`)+(`r cn2`)$$

Answerlist
--------

`r al`

Solution
========

For addition, just add the real components $(`r a`)+(`r c`)=`r a+c`$ and the imaginary components $(`r b`)i+(`r d`)i=`r b+d`i$.
$$`r cn3`$$
